en: A black‑and‑white aerial view of a European town showing a large open central square surrounded by multi‑storey buildings and tree‑lined streets. Smaller houses and institutional buildings extend into the background, with some industrial structures including a tall chimney. In the lower left corner the printed caption reads "Uddevalla från flygplan", and in the lower right there is a publisher/photographer credit.
